audit.whatIsWrong: Text rates the lane TRICKY 7.5/10 but describes Poppy's W as deleting Mel's dashes; Mel has no dash in her kit (Q Radiant Volley, W Rebuttal, E Solar Snare, R Golden Eclipse).
audit.why: Steadfast Presence's dash-stop is dead weight here; the lane is decided by Solar Snare (9-11s root) versus Heroic Charge's 475 range and a wall.
audit.corrected: Difficulty held at 7.5/10 (mirror rates it 6.5/10 from Mel's side, consistent); the false dash-denial line removed and replaced with the Rebuttal/Solar Snare read.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart in both layers reads Mel, Skill, Poppy, Poppy, Mel, Poppy, Poppy — it disagrees with the packet chart and with the mirror audit.
audit.why: Mel out-ranges Poppy 950/1000 to 475 from level 2 on; Poppy does not own levels 3-5, and level 6 is not Mel's (Keeper's Verdict is peel, Golden Eclipse is global damage, not a lane kill button).
audit.corrected: Chart re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers: Skill, Mel, Mel, Skill, Skill, Skill, Poppy — matching the packet and the mirror. Ratings realigned to 5/3/3/5/5/5/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: The pages claim Mel's R reflects Poppy's burst and that W stops her dash. Golden Eclipse (R) does not reflect anything — it detonates Overwhelm stacks globally. Rebuttal (W) is the reflect, on a 38/35/33/29/26s cooldown.
audit.why: Iron Ambassador's buckler is a projectile, so Rebuttal reflects it and blocks the damage entirely; Solar Snare and Radiant Volley are the poke pattern. Timing an all-in around R instead of W gets the player killed.
audit.corrected: Reflect attributed to Rebuttal with its real cooldown; Solar Snare's 1000 range vs Heroic Charge's 475 stated; Golden Eclipse restated as a global Overwhelm detonation, and Searing Brilliance's execute threshold added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Searing Brilliance's execute threshold and its bonus-projectile auto reset are never mentioned.
audit.why: Overwhelm stacks execute above what the health bar suggests, and the loaded auto is the wind-up tell.
audit.corrected: Execute threshold added to the late block and to a don't.

edits.before: This is where you claw it back. Your flat damage does not scale, but Q chunks her squishy max HP regardless of your gold, and W's armor/MR steroid plus the buckler shield let you survive her poke long enough to commit. Bait her R — once that reflect is down she has no defensive layer — then E her into a wall, Q the slam, and trade on your sustain advantage. At 6 your R is peel and disengage, not burst, so do not over-rely on it; the wall stun is your real kill setup.
edits.after: This is where you claw it back. Your flat damage does not scale, but Hammer Shock chunks her squishy max HP regardless of gold, and Steadfast Presence's armor/MR plus the buckler let you survive her poke long enough to commit. Bait Rebuttal — for the next 26-38s she has no defensive layer — then E her into a wall, Q the slam, and trade on sustain. At 6 Keeper's Verdict is peel, not burst, so do not over-rely on it; the wall stun is the kill setup.

edits.before: You reclaim this lane late because Mel is squishy and immobile and you have point-and-click reliability she cannot kite forever — a Flash-E into a wall stun plus max-HP Q deletes her if you catch a step-up. Her R reflect is the one thing that punishes a blind all-in, so always commit your burst AFTER it expires, never into it. Look for picks off vision: she has no dash to escape your E, so one clean engage near terrain ends her.
edits.after: You reclaim this lane late because Mel is squishy and dashless and Heroic Charge is point-and-click — a Flash-E wall stun plus max-HP Hammer Shock deletes her on a step-up. Rebuttal is what punishes a blind all-in, so commit after it, never into it. Watch the Searing Brilliance execute: Overwhelm kills above the health bar's suggestion, so track the number and do not linger low near her.
